$comment: Allowlist for scripts/migration-gates/astryx-token-gate.mjs (P19). ONLY for custom properties whose undeclared-with-fallback shape is a DOCUMENTED design (override hooks whose fallback IS the default). Never allowlist a name to silence a typo — fix the name instead. Each entry needs a reason.

names.name: --modal-z
names.reason: ui-common's modal level stack (useModalLevel in @lablup/ui-common/Modal) writes it inline on each open portal root when it claims a level; BAIDrawerPortal.css reads it with the ladder's modal base as the fallback for a root that has not claimed one yet.

names.name: --board-item-padding-top
names.reason: ui-common Board's documented padding knob: its itemPadding prop writes it on the board root, and --spacing-5 is Board's own default. BAIBoard.css reads it to pad an item whose content has no title row.
